_comment: Single source of truth for company details. Edit, then run: python3 tools/build.py. Items marked VERIFY are listed in COMPANY-CONTENT-CHECKLIST.md.
_phone_note: Mobile and WhatsApp number, confirmed by the company.
_landline_note: Optional office landline. Leave all three blank to hide it everywhere. To re-add it, fill in landline_e164 (+9771XXXXXXX), landline_display (+977 1-XXXXXXX) and landline_local (01-XXXXXXX), then run python3 tools/build.py and python3 tools/build_hero_map.py. Contact page, footer, call-to-action bands, contact banner and Schema.org update automatically.
_form_token_note: FormSubmit private alias for the business inbox (verified). Used instead of the raw email in form endpoints.
